name: am-context-bar
description: A context card above the prompt with a collapsed and an expanded view: zone-coloured token count (dumb zone from 50%), context bar with the dumb zone and auto-compact marked, breakdown by category, limits, model, thinking, compactions, git. Three layouts. /am-context-bar on | off | layout v1|v2|v3.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Shape of the context card: three-rows (full-width bar), two-rows (short bar beside the count) or one-row.

nearingAt.title: Nearing dumb zone at (%)
nearingAt.description: Context percentage where the count turns yellow.

dumbZoneAt.title: Dumb zone starts at (%)
dumbZoneAt.description: Context percentage where the dumb zone starts; marked on the bar and the count turns orange.

compactSoonAt.title: Compact soon at (%)
compactSoonAt.description: Context percentage where the count turns red.
